sloka: सा तु रावण वेगेन पुष्प वृष्टिः समन्ततः ।समाधूता दशग्रीवम् पुनः एव अभ्यवर्तत ॥३-५२-२७॥
transliteration: sā tu rāvaṇa vegena puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ samantataḥ ।samādhūtā daśagrīvam punaḥ eva abhyavartata ॥3-52-27॥

translations.english: The shower of flowers that fell flew towards the tenheaded Ravana again in the swirling motion (of the chariot).
